Title: GotEmail: Native Mac mail with one-click sign-in codes and AI | Product Hunt
# GotEmail. ## Native Mac mail with one-click sign-in codes and AI. GotEmail is a native Mac mail app for people who live in their inbox. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP account in one fast window. Sign-in codes are one click away, AI drafts and summarizes when you ask. Pay once, use on every Mac. Launch tags:Mac•Email•Productivity. I'm Rahul, and together with @uaghazade we make small, native Mac apps at Voprex Labs. Abbas built GotEmail, and today I'm launching it here. • Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one window. • Sign-in codes: the code from a "verify your login" email, one click to copy. • AI that drafts replies and summarizes threads, only when you ask. • Pay once, use on every Mac you own, free updates. We opened it to early buyers a few days ago, and 200 people bought it in launch week. Their feedback shaped the last updates. GotEmail for iPhone is now in beta. For the Product Hunt community: code PRODUCTHUNT gives 35% off for the next 48 hours. We'd love your honest feedback: what would make you switch your mail app, and what's missing?
